notes.title: Please Subscribe launching on February 10th 2022!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35236530/5297018ffb378a9fc6e545750460e12ad5e960a6.png

Today we’re excited to announce the sequel to Gamer Career Tycoon. Our new management tycoon game "Please Subscribe" will be available on February 10th, 2022 for PC via Steam for $9.99 with a 15% launch discount.   

Rise from a small beginner streamer to a worldwide famous influencer or a huge media company. Hire the most legendary video editors, artists, programmers, voice actors, sound artists or music composers. Broadcast your content and influence millons of gamers.

Key Features:

 Create your streamer and develop your own playstyle.
 Broadcast your content and gain worldwide fans.
 Research new options and tools for your channel.
 Learn how to develop your own stream assets.
 Gain new insights in game trends or genre trends to gain hype.
 Increase your relationship status to make deals with platform networks.
 Buy new games, software and hardware in the shop.
 Find work in your local town to earn money on a daily basis
 Build and manage your own media studio and hire professional staff.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1826910/Please_Subscribe/

Add to your Wishlist and Follow!

notes.title: Golden Goal Update (Version 1.08.367++)
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35236530/e0a0d2b172370b03c138b1663ab6cd53bd0daeae.png

Hello everyone! Here is a major update to Football School with even more fixes and improvements. We hope for a smoother experience with the improved gamemenu, faster loading times and the visual updates. The matches should be more exciting to watch with the golden goal overtime rule. Introducing players to the mechanics in the game has been one of our biggest challenges. Condition labs and intensity training are now unlocked in the beginning. We added tutorials regarding which attributes to focus on in the early game. We also added "Team learning" in competitions to make sure that players gain stats much faster. And much more. Enjoy!

Here are the patch notes(v1.08.367++):

 Golden goal added to overtime (next goal wins the game)
 Added sandbox feature, play custom games with your own setup
 Reworked all arena pitch textures (it looks much nicer)
 Players now start with condition labs and intensity training
 Added visual feedback for total debt amount in finances
 Added option to pay off full loan amount in finances
 Added visual feedback in team coach for available player perks
 Added tutorial message to practice regarding kick training
 Added passive perk "team learning" to all competitions 
 Players now gains stat increase as reward from competitions
 100% chance to gain stat bonus when tournament is finished
 Game menu will now auto roll up after closing another menu
 Starting perk "For the fans" now give club marketing rank3
 Starting perk "Skilled team" now gives starting players level3
 Starting perk "Good business" now gives clubshop2 (250 products)
 Added more sponsor events

notes.title: 4 DAYS LEFT TO LAUNCH...
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35236530/250aae6db17197e83dda822c88dfd5ffeb9e216d.png
Football School is arriving to Steam this Thursday, January 9th!

CREATE YOUR TEAM...Pick the right combination of novice players for your starting team. There are 3 classes to choose from. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35236530/168f1676c9ef866a2c548586a4264d8f1b2e7008.jpg

PLAYER CLASSES...Each class has a unique special ability on the pitch that can be improved and become very powerful.

STRIKER{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35236530/4de80d1fbf6a79de3ba70f8310d3db7c12ade109.png
Strikers has the special ability to kick the ball so hard that everyone it hits gets knocked out.

MIDFIELDER{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35236530/2d5f0ef69992bf7eedb12f578028288f25a7b80a.png
Midfielders has the special ability to regenerate stamina for his teammates when handling the ball.

DEFENDER{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35236530/0b2571ec2b91b21f490db9614859400092f0f79e.png
Defenders has the special ability to tackle down and knock out opponents.
		
TRAIN YOUR TEAM....You can assign your players to training that will increase their stats and skill.  How will you choose to prepare them for competition?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35236530/b4c51ae316afa12e09b95c490f41b57ab550a4af.jpg

KICK{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35236530/4d8c9148e72c6a889d8538c804a08e6261a3694c.png
Kick affects how hard and accurate a player can kick the ball.

SPEED{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35236530/14df932ea080e1405b260998e31cf7899860e8f8.png
Speed affects how fast a player can move, react and take decisions.

STAMINA{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35236530/d4e332e4f3ba39b28287d2770ec668cbe99ae8e3.png
Stamina affects how much a player can do on the field before getting tired and must rest.

BODY{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35236530/59a295015f083980277a7179d7707018d86e4903.png
Body makes the player recover faster from getting stunned by tackles or shots. Body also affects defenders tackle ability and makes it stun opponents longer.


SPECIALITY PERKS...You will be able to choose speciality perks for your players. Any player class can choose any speciality. Every time your team plays a friendly or competitive football match they will gain experience based on their performance. For example the player with the best rating gets a player of the game bonus and will get a huge XP bonus.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35236530/d6541f16ab708e63f47bf0d69d2123a2e5a93ad4.jpg

Goalkeeper{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35236530/12d07fd3f9de13a99ea6463386f1c3e56e99bf2e.png

Dribbler{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35236530/689117b742b7e4c985fa5b7abdd28129bf615691.png

Shooter{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35236530/e8c35c0f1bef0ee993371dd9462a9c8e111e0204.png

Goalscorer{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35236530/01f008dc5beeed8ad306773198b193012ec9f986.png

TACTICS...
One part of your job is to coach your team. In Football School you have access to create your own custom team formation. Your players positions on the field can be key to victory. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35236530/3d83d883d43d529c73856b39e961e926b34b627a.jpg
You can try out many ways in combination with team compositions and tactics settings. 

Don't Forget to Wishlist
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1087110/Football_School/
